key_insight: DemoPSD replaces full teacher imitation with disagreement-adaptive, reverse-KL barycenter distillation to reduce privileged-information leakage while preserving exploration.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical training strategy for reasoning LLMs that can improve cross-domain robustness without sacrificing token-level supervision.
method: Measure teacher–student distribution disagreement at each token.
Blend teacher and student via a reverse-KL barycenter target instead of matching the full teacher distribution.
Adapt the blending strength dynamically to selectively adopt teacher guidance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on SciKnowEval across four scientific fields, with better performance than GRPO and SDPO, higher training entropy, and stronger out-of-distribution generalization on GPQA.
watch_item: Dynamic token-level blending adds implementation complexity and may be sensitive to how disagreement is estimated and scheduled during training.
